description: This file defines the ReviewerUserRole class in the OrangeHRM system, managing access rights for reviewers based on their roles. It includes methods to retrieve accessible entity IDs such as Employees, Performance Trackers, and Performance Tracker Logs for the reviewer, utilizing traits and external services.

classes.name: ReviewerUserRole
classes.description: A user role class that manages reviewer permissions and accessible entity IDs within the HRM system.

methods.name: getAccessibleIdsForEntity
methods.description: Returns entity IDs accessible to the reviewer based on entity type and permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleEmployeeIdsForReviewer
methods.description: Retrieves employee IDs that the reviewer can access, based on specific permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleTrackerIdsForReviewer
methods.description: Retrieves performance tracker IDs accessible to the reviewer.

methods.name: getAccessibleTrackerLogIdsForReviewer
methods.description: Retrieves performance tracker log IDs accessible to the reviewer.
